meta.name: support-operations
meta.description: Designs and runs the support function — channels, queues, routing, staffing, service levels, quality, and the metrics that show whether it is working. Use this to set up or fix support operations, choose channels, size a team, set or renegotiate service levels, reduce cost per contact, diagnose long queues or poor quality, or decide what to automate.

copy.tagline: 搭建并优化客服支持流程,降低单次联系成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在管理客服团队并想优化服务流程与成本。
copy.tagline_en: Design and optimize your support operations to cut costs and improve service.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a support team and want to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

howto.what: Claude会按照技能中的方法，帮你分析客服需求、设计支持流程，并围绕渠道、服务水平、指标、人员配置、质量等给出具体建议。
howto.when: 当你说要搭建或修复客服运营、选择支持渠道、设定或重谈服务水平等时触发。

say.text: 我想设计客服支持流程，该从哪里入手？
say.note: Claude会要求你提供近期联系样本并分类分析。

say.text: 怎么设定服务水平，才能确保团队接得住？
say.note: Claude会提醒你先按实际产能核对承诺。

say.text: 哪些客服环节适合自动化？
say.note: Claude会按处理层级建议先消除、转移等低成本方式。

howto.what_en: Claude applies the skill's framework to analyze support demand, design handling flows, and advise on channels, service levels, metrics, staffing, and quality.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or fix support operations, choose channels, set or renegotiate service levels, or diagnose queues and quality.

say_en.text: I want to design support operations. Where do I start?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for recent contact samples to categorize.

say_en.text: How do I set service levels we can actually staff to?
say_en.note: Claude will check commitments against real capacity.

say_en.text: Which support tasks should we automate?
say_en.note: Claude will apply the cost-ordered hierarchy to suggest options.
